**Approval Note R-2247**

This approval note summarises the findings and recommendations from the inspection report on equipment R-2247 (Reactor Unit CCR - Continuous Catalytic Reformer). The key points are:

* Five findings were recorded, including:
	+ F-01: Insulation cladding damaged and displaced over a 2 m section of the vapour line.
	+ F-02: Localised external corrosion observed on shell plate adjacent to support saddle.
	+ F-03: Support saddle anchor bolt at south-west location found loose.
	+ F-04: Ladder and platform grating adjacent to manway found corroded with section loss exceeding 20% at two treads.
	+ F-05: Minor external scaling and paint chalking on head section.
* Three of the five findings (F-01, F-02, and F-04) require immediate attention to prevent water ingress or further damage.

The ultrasonic thickness survey results show that one location (CML-03) is below the minimum required value of 12.7 mm.

**Recommendations:**

* Reinstate cladding and seal joints to prevent water ingress (F-01).
* Remove loose scale, surface prepare to St-3 and re-apply approved coating system during next available shutdown (F-02).
* Replace affected grating sections before next internal inspection (F-04).

I hereby approve the findings and recommendations from the inspection report on equipment R-2247. I accept that these actions are necessary to ensure safe operation of the reactor.
